blocks.text: Origin / creation. Era −2 Bridge practices professionalized into orders maintaining contact between DBA worlds and the receding human world.
Identity / human status. Artificial orders with unnamed human counterparts. Membership included translators, security specialists, diplomats, archivists, and route maintainers.
Importance. They carried human information, negotiated rare reciprocal contacts, and kept alive the possibility that the DBA were not a completely closed history.

Decline or loss. Human infrastructure and politics changed, trusted counterparts vanished, and extraction during the Second Harvest destroyed credibility. Last Bridges closed, disappeared, or were silenced.
Final status / surviving function. No order remains active after Era Two. The External Gate inherits boundary translation, consent controls, and limited contact without inheriting a Bridge identity.
